title: record.json — completed-record (local bundles)
description: Written by the record verb in the verdict CLI for local and provider-PR bundles (GitHub PRs use post). findings/open are recomputed from the merged store every run; confidence/security_summary are null when the review carried none. additionalProperties stays open for additive provenance fields.

status.description: Bundle provider that was recorded (e.g. local).

head.description: Reviewed SHA (real head_sha, or "dirty"/"unknown" when the bundle has none).

diff_sha256.description: SHA-256 of full.diff at record time.

recorded_at.description: UTC timestamp of the record run.

tool_version.description: Tool version that wrote this record (from package.json).

prompts_hash.description: sha256 over the sorted prompt-set file names plus contents (SKILL.md plus prompts/system.md, prompts/review.md, prompts/diagrams.md).

model.description: First model of the latest cost record, else null when no cost record names one.

patch_id.description: Bundle patch id at record time, copied from identity.json; absent when the bundle had no identity.

patch_id_kind.description: Patch id algorithm (git-patch-id or the labeled diff-sha256 fallback); absent when the bundle had no identity.

repairs.description: Safe review.json rewrites applied before the merge, in document order; absent when the review was already clean.
